negative_direction: Coherent and graded. From c=-2 to -40, the tokens gaining probability move from pain / warmth / heat / discomfort to stimulus / receptor / reflex. At c=-5 and -10, 'Before the big presentation, I felt' continues 'the pain' instead of the baseline 'nervous'. The steering swaps the psychological sense of the word for the physical one. This matches the - pole label (felt bodily sensation).
positive_direction: Coherent at small doses. From c=+2 to +10, the gaining tokens are calmly, inspired, strongly, powerful, passionate, proud: composure and fortitude. At +5, 'Before the big presentation, I felt nervous … very nervous' intensifies the psychological state. Above +20 the text degenerates (repetition, then symbols). The concept tokens themselves (' nerve', ' nervous') do not rise, which fits a layer-9 detector whose job is to represent the sense, not to say the word.
monosemanticity_reading: Both directions stay on one axis, psychological strain/composure (+) versus bodily sensation (-). No unrelated content appeared at any dose before degeneration.
caveats: Single-neuron steering at ±10-40x the corpus max is far outside natural activations, and greedy generations from 4 prompts are anecdotal.
